meaning.reachable: Server returned a 2xx or 3xx response (after following redirects).
meaning.failed: Server returned 404 or 410: the page is likely gone.
meaning.blocked: Server refused or rate-limited the checker (401, 403, 429, 451, 999). The page may still exist.
meaning.inconclusive: Timeout, TLS or connection error, 5xx or another code. Nothing was established.
